parse_fields.spec: Split on unescaped commas. A backslash quotes the next character, whatever it is. Preserve empty fields including the last. A trailing backslash is literal.
parse_fields.buggy:
def parse_fields(text):
    return [part.replace(r"\,", ",") for part in text.split(",") if part]

latest_records.spec: Each record is [key, timestamp, value]. Return a dictionary of values at the greatest timestamp at or before cutoff for each key. At the same timestamp prefer the later input. A winning null (None) deletes that key.

allocate_units.spec: Allocate a nonnegative integer number of units proportionally to nonnegative integer weights. Start with floors, then assign remaining units by descending fractional remainder, breaking ties by lower index. All-zero weights return all zeros.

dependency_order.spec: Map job names to prerequisite lists. Include prerequisite-only names. Return the lexicographically smallest topological order, or an empty list if any cycle exists. Repeated prerequisites count once.

water_peak.spec: Each interval is [start, end, nonnegative load], active on start <= time < end. Return [earliest time of maximum total load, maximum load]. If the maximum is zero, return [None, 0]. Empty intervals contribute nothing.
water_peak.buggy:
def water_peak(events):
    if not events:
        return [None, 0]
    points = sorted({t for start, end, _ in events for t in (start, end)})
    totals = [(sum(w for s, e, w in events if s <= t <= e), t) for t in points]
    load, time = max(totals)
    return [time, load]

expand_alias.spec: Words are separated by whitespace. Expand words found in aliases recursively. Alias values are strings of zero or more words. For a cycle, emit the word that repeats on the current expansion path and stop that branch. Join output words with one space.
expand_alias.buggy:
def expand_alias(text, aliases):
    return " ".join(aliases.get(word, word) for word in text.split())

best_segment.spec: Return [start, end] for a nonempty contiguous segment with maximum sum, using an exclusive end. Break ties by shorter length, then lower start. Empty input returns None. Values may all be negative.

next_slot.spec: Return the earliest integer time at or after start for a slot of duration that does not overlap any busy interval. Busy intervals are unsorted, may overlap, and use half-open endpoints. Ignore empty intervals. Duration zero returns start.
